verdict.rationale: The firm publishes a public blog post, 'visa options for entrepreneurs'. It explains the E-2 investor visa, the B-1-in-contemplation-of-E-2 setup visit, and a worked O-1 entrepreneur scenario, so this is first-party free explainer content for founders. The evidence shows only this single post, and its depth on criteria and process is unproven. missing for 10: substantial multi-guide library on startup visas, detailed eligibility criteria breakdowns, step-by-step process explainers, real client case examples, explicit confirmation that the content is ungated, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider publishes substantial free guides on startup visas — criteria breakdowns, process explainers, real examples — open to anyone, not gated lead bait

citations.quote: This is a visa that would allow you to invest in the US business and once you get the visa you would manage and control the business.
we could apply for a B-1 in contemplation of an E-2 visa for a six-month visit that would allow you to come to get things set up
